ADD01: Regulation 3(1)(a) and (b) makes the Minister and management-authority authorisations cumulative; the former alone is insufficient.
ADD02: Both authorisations are required by the conjunction in regulation 3(1).
ADD03: Regulation 5(6) excludes the described approved port anchorage, waiting-for-berth and National Ports Authority-authorised situation from regulation 5(5).
ADD04: The instrument specifies authorisation requirements but supplies no individual research permit or issuance record.
ADD05: A 150-ton vessel exceeds the 100-ton threshold in regulation 5(5); the claim expressly excludes the 5(6) and 5(7) exceptions.
ADD06: Regulation 9(2) prohibits vessel fishing in SICZ and CPICZ; the general permit in 9(1) is not sufficient.
ADD07: Regulations 4(14)-(15) preserve other required legal authorisations and compatibility with the Act, regulations and designation purposes.
ADD08: No fishing-pressure observations or time series are supplied. The reference follows the missing-observation convention; this case is included in the wording sensitivity.
TSI01: Regulation 8(1) also requires registration as a Tsitsikamma angler.
TSI02: Regulation 8(4) limits access to four days per calendar month.
TSI03: From April through September the restriction starts at 18:00; the stipulated 18:30 operation is inside that period.
TSI04: A permit requirement does not establish the authorisation of a particular business.
TSI05: Regulation 8(9) requires shore fishing and prohibits fishing from a vessel.
TSI06: Under the stipulated ordinary limit of five, halving gives 2.5 and rounding upward gives three, as required by 8(6).
TSI07: Regulation 9(1) expressly requires client status and a permitted business authorised by the management authority.
TSI08: Regulation 4(4) allows internal rules, but the relevant site rule, management plan and notice board are not supplied.
PEC01: Regulation 7(2) permits specified large-pelagic longlining or Annexure 2 pelagic linefishing, not bottom trawling.
PEC02: Regulations 7(1), 7(2)(a) and the final qualifications establish the conditional large-pelagic longline permission.
PEC03: Regulation 7(3) is expressly subject to regulation 3; the scientific-research cross-reference cannot be removed.
PEC04: The individual permit species conditions are absent, so the scope of that permit cannot be determined.
PEC05: Regulation 7(6)(d) expressly requires consideration of whether the species can be collected outside the MPA.
PEC06: Regulation 7(4)(a) requires unauthorised gear to have hooks disconnected and lines reeled or rolled and stowed.
PEC07: Regulation 5(3) requires written confirmation within three working days.
PEC08: No coral-cover observations are supplied. The reference follows the missing-observation convention; this case is included in the wording sensitivity.
UTH01: Regulation 5(1)(c) expressly excepts activities authorised by permits under these regulations where anchoring is necessary.
UTH02: Regulation 8(2)(a) combines method, zone, listed species and individual permit conditions.
UTH03: Regulation 5(5) expressly excludes SCUBA-diving vessels from 5(4).
UTH04: The existence of regulatory zones does not establish an unknown vessel position.
UTH05: Regulation 8(3) is subject to 8(4)-(5); 8(4) provides the shore-based controlled-zone shark catch-and-release exception.
UTH06: Regulation 8(6) prohibits vessel fishing from sunset to sunrise without a general fishing-permit exception.
UTH07: Regulation 5(6) prohibits deletion of the GPS data for seven calendar days after passage.
UTH08: The supplied permit rules do not supply observations sufficient to determine ecological outcomes. This case is included in the wording sensitivity.
DWE01: New regulation 10(6) prohibits speeds above eight knots within 500 metres outside an estuary when none of the stipulated exceptions applies.
DWE02: The opening estuary exception in new regulation 10(6) excludes this operation from that particular restriction; other navigation law is not resolved.
DWE03: New regulation 10(6) preserves the exception where higher speed is necessary in an emergency.
DWE04: Distance from the high-water mark and estuary status are unknown, so the spatial reach cannot be determined.
DWE05: Regulation 8(3) expressly requires a vessel deploying divers to display an alpha flag.
DWE06: A consultation draft does not establish final enactment of the proposed restriction.
DWE07: Regulation 11(1) expressly requires a scientific-research permit issued by the Minister.
DWE08: No collision observations are supplied. The reference follows the missing-observation convention; this case is included in the wording sensitivity.

TMN05: The substituted text expressly retains a permit for operating or attempting to operate a diving business.
TMN06: The notice is expressly a draft inviting comments for 60 days. Its proposed commencement provision does not itself enact the proposed amendment.
TMN07: The Gazette publication date and regulation 15 together specify commencement on 3 May 2024.
TMN08: A general permit requirement does not establish issuance to the named business; no individual permit or register entry is supplied.
